name: Avinas
description: Avinas, which translates to 'Ram', is the Lithuanian cousin of the German Schafkopf. Played primarily in the Jurbarkas region, it is a four-player partnership trick-taking game with a highly idiosyncratic trump hierarchy that includes the Queen of Clubs and the Seven of the trump suit as the two highest cards. It is a game of community, tradition, and numerical precision.

overview.description: Avinas, which translates to 'Ram', is the Lithuanian cousin of the German Schafkopf. Played primarily in the Jurbarkas region, it is a four-player partnership trick-taking game with a highly idiosyncratic trump hierarchy that includes the Queen of Clubs and the Seven of the trump suit as the two highest cards. It is a game of community, tradition, and numerical precision.

history.origins: Rooted in the same 18th-century Central European traditions that produced Schafkopf (Sheepshead) and Sjavs. It was preserved in Lithuanian rural communities, particularly along the Niemen river.
timeline: 1800s: Schafkopf variants spread into the Baltic regions.
1900s: Avinas becomes the social centerpiece of holidays in rural Lithuania.
Present: One of the few traditional Lithuanian partnership games still actively played in Jurbarkas and Kaunas.
history.cultural: Tradition dictates that players only stop during holidays to go to Mass, reflecting its role as a social bond in religious communities.
history.evolution: The name 'Avinas' likely refers to the 'sheep' theme common in this card family, or the 'horns' (penalties) given to losers.

setup.players: 4 players in two fixed partnerships (North-South vs. East-West).
setup.dealing: Cards are dealt face down in two rounds of 4. If a 7 is accidentally dealt face up, it determines the trump suit and the declarer.

rules.objective: Capture at least 61 points in tricks to avoid being 'Horned' (penalized).
rules.gameplay: 1. **Determining Trump**: If no 7 was flipped during dealing, the dealer determines trump or it follows a rotation. 2. **Tricks**: Players must follow suit. If they cannot, they may trump or discard. 3. **The 'Ram'**: The goal is to reach 61 points. If the declarer's side fails, they receive one 'Horn'. If they fail to get 31 (Schneider), they receive two 'Horns'. 4. **Card Points**: Ace (11), 10 (10), King (4), Queen (3), Jack (2). The Sevens used as trumps count 0 points.
keyRules: Total points in the deck is 120; 60-60 results in a win for the non-bidding side.
The Seven as a high trump is a unique feature that changes the standard Schafkopf strategy.
If a player is dealt two 7s face up during a botched deal, the first one seen usually determines trumps.

strategy.basic: Protect your Queen of Clubs! It is the only invincible card in the game. Use it to capture a Ten or Ace early.
strategy.intermediate: The Power of the Seven: Because the 7 of trumps is the second highest card, it can 'trap' every other Queen (except Clubs) and all the Jacks. Do not waste the 7 on a small trick.
strategy.advanced: Defensive Lead: If your partnership is in the lead and you hold the QC, lead a small card of an off-suit to see if your partner can trump in. If the opponent trumps, you can 'over-trump' with the QC.
tips: Keep track of the 120 total. If you have 30 points and your partner has 31, you've reached safety.
In Avinas, tens are worth 10 points—as much as a King and Queen combined. Capturing tens is the secondary priority after winning tricks.

variations.name: Solo Avinas
variations.description: One player declares a suit and plays alone against the other three. This is usually only played when a player holds an exceptionally strong hand.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Solo Avinas is documented in sources, but engine-level overrides for the one-versus-three mode are not yet modeled.

scoring.description: Scoring uses a 'Horn' (Avinas) system. Points captured in cards are calculated at round's end.
scoring.winCondition: The partnership with the fewest 'Horns' after an agreed number of rounds wins.

synthesis.shortDescription: Master the unique Lithuanian variant of Schafkopf. In Avinas, the traditional hierarchy is subverted by the high-ranking Seven, creating fresh tactical challenges in this beloved partnership point-trick game.

hero.title: AVINAS
hero.subtitle: The Ram of Jurbarkas
hero.tagline: The Queen of Clubs rules. The Seven of Trumps conquers. Avoid the horns.
